statement: SK Telecom will build a 2-gigawatt-scale AI Cloud in Korea on the NVIDIA DSX platform with Vera Rubin accelerators and SK hynix HBM4 memory.
why: A named platform win at gigawatt scale locks a large future deployment onto NVIDIA silicon rather than a competing accelerator or in-house ASIC.

impact.mechanism: Committing a 2-gigawatt cloud to NVIDIA DSX and Vera Rubin creates pull-through demand for merchant GPUs, HBM4, power and cooling.

evidence.excerpt: SK Telecom will build a 2-gigawatt-scale AI Cloud in Korea using the NVIDIA DSX platform and Vera Rubin accelerators powered by SK hynix HBM4 memory.

confidence.basis: Primary source: NVIDIA investor relations press release naming the platform and the customer.
